candidateEvaluations.strategy: A 7-component rich screen structured for a multi-goal Long-Term Planner. Features POINTS_BALANCE, three dedicated goal cards (Retirement Fund, Children Education Fund, Dream Home Deposit), an ADD_GOAL_CARD, FUTURE_VALUE_CARD, PROJECTION_CHART, and EDUCATIONAL_INSIGHT_CARD.
